All are DDA bottom-up.

scope: For the comparison between H9 hESCs and their differentiated neuronal counterparts (Supplementary Table 1 and Supplementary Data 1), we performed tandem mass tag (TMT) proteomics. 50 µg of protein were precipitated with 23% TCA.

For the comparison between control and CSDE1 KD H9 hESCs (Supplementary Table 3 and Supplementary Data 3), we performed label-free quantitative (LFQ) proteomics. Cells were collected in urea buffer (8 M urea, 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and 1x complete protease inhibitor mix with EDTA (Roche)), homogenized with a syringe and cleared using centrifugation (16,000 g, 20 min).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The text describes multiple proteomics experiments. The TMT and LFQ experiments used total protein precipitates or homogenized cell supernatants (whole cell lysate). While a separate interactome analysis used immunoprecipitation (purified protein or complex), the primary quantitative proteomics datasets (PXD007738, PXD007270, PXD007271) were performed on whole cell lysates.
